description: Core bridge behavior settings. Maps to mautrix bridgev2/bridgeconfig.BridgeConfig.

command_prefix.description: Prefix for bridge commands in the management room.

personal_filtering_spaces.description: Enable personal filtering spaces for portal rooms.

private_chat_portal_meta.description: Set portal room metadata (name/avatar) in private chats.

split_portals.description: Create separate portal rooms per user login.

resend_bridge_info.description: Resend bridge info state events on startup.

no_bridge_info_state_key.description: Don't include the bridge info state key in portal rooms.

unknown_error_auto_reconnect.description: Duration to wait before auto-reconnecting after an unknown error (Go duration, e.g. '1m').

unknown_error_max_auto_reconnects.description: Maximum number of auto-reconnect attempts after unknown errors.

bridge_matrix_leave.description: Bridge Matrix leave events to the remote network.

bridge_notices.description: Bridge m.notice messages to the remote network.

tag_only_on_create.description: Only set room tags when creating a portal, not on updates.

only_bridge_tags.description: Only bridge rooms with these tags.

mute_only_on_create.description: Only set mute status when creating a portal, not on updates.

deduplicate_matrix_messages.description: Deduplicate Matrix messages before bridging to avoid double-sends.

cross_room_replies.description: Support replies across different portal rooms.

outgoing_message_re_id.description: Re-identify outgoing messages with the remote network ID.

revert_failed_state_changes.description: Revert Matrix state changes that failed to bridge.

kick_matrix_users.description: Kick Matrix users from portal rooms when they are removed on the remote network.

phone_numbers_in_profile.description: Include phone numbers in ghost user profiles.

permissions.description: User/server permission map. Keys are '*' (wildcard), 'example.com' (server), or '@user:example.com' (user).

CleanupAction.description: Action to take on portal rooms during cleanup.

enabled.description: Enable cleanup of portal rooms on logout.

manual.description: Cleanup behavior when a user manually logs out.

bad_credentials.description: Cleanup behavior when credentials become invalid.

mode.description: Filter mode: 'allow' only allows listed items, 'deny' blocks listed items.

list.description: Portal IDs to allow/deny. Each item is a portal ID string or an object with id and optional receiver.

always_deny_from_login.description: User login IDs that are always denied portal creation.
